programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc:
In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range.
Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots.
From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff venture deep into Maine’s backcountry with their buddy Chuck, ice fishing remote lakes only reachable by snowmobile. Their journey ends at the legendary “ghost trains,” a pair of abandoned locomotives that now rest as silent monuments to a forgotten logging era.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff scour the rugged mountains of southern Arizona in search of the elusive Coues deer, known to hunters as the “Grey Ghost.” Through scorching sun and shifting winds, they test their skill and patience chasing one of North America’s most elusive big game animals.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way team continue their African journey with hunts for both the majestic Kudu and elusive Golden Wildebeest. The experience comes full circle when the meat from these animals is donated to local schoolchildren, who receive not only fresh meals but also school supplies and sweets that light up the village.

programme.title: S1E2 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Trenten Merrill, an American Paralympic long jumper who claimed bronze at the 2020 Summer Paralympics. Also featured is Casey Patterson, a powerhouse in professional beach volleyball with numerous AVP tournament wins, a gold medal on the FIVB World Tour, and an appearance at the 2016 Rio Olympics alongside Jake Gibb. Tennis legends Bob and Mike Bryan, the most successful doubles team in history, take the spotlight with 16 Grand Slam titles, 119 ATP Tour doubles victories, 438 weeks as the world’s No. 1 team, and Olympic gold in 2012. Rounding out the episode is acclaimed gymnastics coach Liang Chow, celebrated for guiding Gabby Douglas to the 2012 Olympic all-around gold and coaching Shawn Johnson to multiple medals at the 2008 Olympics.

programme.title: S1E3 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Paul Rabil, legendary professional lacrosse player and co-founder of the Premier Lacrosse League, celebrated as one of the greatest in the sport’s history. Also featured is Britney Henry, a standout track and field athlete from the University of Oregon who captured the Pac-10 Conference title in the hammer throw. Rounding out the episode is Meagan Martin, trailblazing competitor as the first female rookie to complete the American Ninja Warrior course and the first-ever Women’s Champion of the series.

programme.title: S1E1 Draft Story
programme.desc: In Part 1, we uncover the story of Tyvis Powell and the people who shaped him into the man and football player he is today. His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S1 E2 Draft Story
programme.desc: A Draft Story” Part 2 is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he takes the leap into professional football. Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - CARS AND MUSIC STARS
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DRAGSTER DIPLOMACY
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - SMOKIN JOE
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - HOLLYWOOD MAKEOVER
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - WOODIE WAGONS
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 4 Ep. 6 - Rescue Under Fire
programme.desc: Red Cat thermal drones hunt the hidden snipers before one final force-on-force evolution gives way to the real mission: rescuing a child from human traffickers.

programme.title: The Fight Beyond Survival
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with a mission focused on combating human trafficking as Don Mann, Jeff Tiegs, Sheriff Mark Lamb and Jenn Stankus introduce contestants with powerful reasons to compete.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 4 Ep. 2 - Paintball on Steroids
programme.desc: With the brutal PRT finally behind them, the contestants shift into full mission-training mode. Tactical intensity ramps up fast as UTM’s Tony Lambraia introduces force-on-force training ammunition described as “paintball on steroids,” preparing the team for the realities of close-quarters tactics and high-pressure scenarios. As training escalates, the mission becomes deeply personal. Skull Games continues its fight against the growing crisis of sex trafficking in America, targeting predators where they operate most: online. Contestant and survivor AnnMarie shares her powerful story of resilience, while the founder of Fireborn speaks on helping women escape abuse and reclaim their lives. Jeff Tiegs leads the team through a knife-fighting course with Hinderer Knives, emphasizing the critical importance of the OODA Loop observe, orient, decide, act. And just as the contestants begin to find their rhythm, a chilling mission warning order changes everything.

programme.title: Eyes in the Sky
programme.desc: With the human trafficking mission warning order in effect, preparation shifts into high gear. Don Mann wastes no time putting the team through one of his signature challenges: a brutal log PT evolution over unforgiving terrain. Hauling a massive log over rocks, under vehicles, and even up a tree, the contestants quickly learn that teamwork and determination can turn the impossible into reality. As mission readiness becomes the focus, the team gets a look at cutting-edge equipment from Flux Defense and the technology that could make all the difference in the field. The action heats up when Genesis Arms demonstrates specialized anti-drone weaponry, turning the sky into a showcase of explosive precision. But the real challenge begins when the contestants pair up for sniper hide construction In a mission where staying hidden could mean everything, the contestants discover that sometimes the best way to survive is to never be seen at all.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 4 Ep. 4 - Shield and Strike
programme.desc: The mission draws closer as the contestants sharpen their close-quarters combat skills with an intense day of tactical training. Under the guidance of the UTM team, they learn the fundamentals of clearing floor plans before progressing to high-stress scenarios involving moving targets, where speed, communication, and decision-making are put to the test. Next, TC Burton unveils an armored vehicle designed to enhance the team’s mission capabilities, while Gear Head Works introduces a telescoping brace system that improves weapon control and reduces fatigue under load. The day concludes with one-handed shooting drills behind a ballistic shield, a demanding exercise that challenges contestants to maintain accuracy and composure while operating under protection. As mission day approaches, the contestants learn that mastering tactics is only half the battle. The real challenge is performing when every second counts.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

programme.title: Freelancers
programme.desc: The son (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) of a fallen police officer joins the NYPD, where he falls in with his father's former partner and a band of rogue cops.

programme.title: Snoop Dogg's Hood of Horror
programme.desc: The Hound of Hell (Snoop Dogg) is a guide through three stories from a neighborhood of depraved citizens. There is a tagger who discovers that not all gangsters die hard, a foolish Texas oil fortune heir who kills for money but can't afford to stay living, and a huge rap star who uncovers a few skeletons in his dressing room that try to kick down his door.

programme.title: Black Outside
programme.desc: Gary Wilkerson Jr. embarks on the adventure of a lifetime as he hikes 2,600 miles from Mexico to Canada on the Pacific Crest Trail.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

programme.title: Cops and Robbers
programme.desc: A hostage negotiator plays a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a cornered bank robber who is hell-bent on getting out of the bank and humiliating the negotiator in the process.

programme.title: Traffik
programme.desc: Brea and John embark on a romantic weekend getaway to an isolated estate in the mountains. They are pleasantly surprised when two of their friends, Darren and Malia, also show up unexpectedly. Their plans for fun soon give way to terror when members of a violent biker gang invade the peaceful countryside. Banded together, they now find themselves in a fight for their lives as their assailants will stop at nothing to protect their secrets from the outside world.

programme.title: Cut Throat City
programme.desc: When Hurricane Katrina devastates New Orleans, four desperate friends band together to pull off a daring heist in the heart of the city.

programme.title: Slow Burn
programme.desc: As ambitious District Attorney Ford Cole (Ray Liotta) prepares for his mayoral bid, he faces conflicting stories surrounding a man's death. His assistant DA and sometime lover, Nora Timmer (Jolene Blalock), claims that the man tried to rape her. However, witness Luther Pinks (LL Cool J) tells a different tale. He says that, actually, she tried to seduce the victim to gather information about a mob chieftain.

programme.title: Caught in the Crossfire
programme.desc: Two detectives (Chris Klein, Richard T. Jones) are targeted by gangsters and crooked cops as they investigate an important case.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: El Dandy y Sus Mujeres
programme.desc: Un hombre finge diferentes profesiones para provocar admiración de sus muchas conquistas y recibir dinero de ellas.

programme.title: El Placer de la Venganza
programme.desc: Una doctora y su familia son agredidos durante un robo, y después se encuentra a un joven que tomó parte en el ataque.

programme.title: Fútbol de alcoba
programme.desc: Un equipo de fútbol femenino se dirige a la capital para competir. Para reforzarlo, el entrenador se viste de mujer.

programme.title: Noche de muerte
programme.desc: Un delincuente se disfraza como un famoso luchador y asalta varios lugares matando a los guardias de seguridad.

programme.title: Dos valientes
programme.desc: Martín, un pistolero, es asesinado, pero antes de morir pide que le oculten su identidad a su hijo. Este corre peligro cuando asiste a su funeral.

programme.title: Santo: Infraterrestre
programme.desc: Las fuerzas del bien se enfrentan a las malévolas intenciones de los Infraterrestres, seres de otro planeta que intentarán apoderarse de la Tierra.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera
programme.desc: Un mecánico inexperto en el deporte de la lucha libre vive toda una aventura cuando se enfrenta a un luchador asesino.

programme.title: El caudillo
programme.desc: Un valiente revolucionario es buscado por las tropas federales, pero el pueblo lo ayuda a esconderse y luego a escapar.

programme.title: Con el Odio en la Piel
programme.desc: Un sheriff y sus malévolos secuaces humillan y asesinan a los mexicanos que viven en un pueblo fronterizo de Texas.

programme.title: Milagro en el Barrio
programme.desc: Un niño ciego y el hijo de una rica familia se hacen amigos aún en contra de la voluntad de la madre del último.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: February (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In the northern hemisphere February is one of the toughest months of the year, the seemingly unending cold and scarce food of winter. Some animals fail, but their bodies become a bounty that will see carnivores and scavengers through. In parts of Africa animals face the opposite problem, high temperatures and overdue rains and must trek to find food and water. While the Amazon has the opposite problem, too much water, with the rainforest wildlife having to adapt to a submerged forest.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Where the South Pacific Ocean meets the Tasman Sea, thirteen islands stretch across the blue desert as if a giant has tossed rocks from the sky above, Manawatāwhi/ The Three Kings Islands. Ancient, wild, and remote, this ocean junction bewitches many who visit. Upwellings of cold nutrient rich water support a spectacle of marine life, while a small pod of Bottlenose Dolphins has given up their nomadic ways to make this place their home.

programme.title: Meet the Pigs
programme.desc: What first comes to mind when you think of pigs? Mud wallows and pink, curly tails? Perhaps lucky symbols and money banks, or maybe just bacon sandwiches? Whatever it is, you're probably underestimating the world's amazing collection of pigs. Today they might be one of our favourite farm animals, but if we visit their cousins in the wild we start to reveal the unique and wonderful world of the pig.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness. A new volunteer arrives in time to see the release, but will it end in disaster?

programme.title: Wolves - Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From arctic tundra to the great planes, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword. Though magnificent predators on their own, the feature that perhaps makes wolves so iconic is the pack. The close bonds, complex communication and sheer muscle of a team of wolves is almost unstoppable. And the pack's not just the day job, it's the cornerstone of family life for a wolf.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Few things make us shiver like the thought of falling prey to one of the world's great predators. With teeth, claws, stings and venom, they inflict death on their prey, and instil fear in us. But who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dan-gerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom, imagining close shaves with all the planet's most dangerous creatures.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Between the continents of North and South America is a tropical paradise: the Caribbean. This archipelago of over 7,000 islands and reefs lies within the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea. From just a few metres wide, to hundreds of kilometres across, every island is different, and each has its own unique wildlife.
programme.sub-title: The Caribbean: The Wild Side of Paradise

programme.title: British Garden: Life And Death On Your Lawn
programme.desc: The British back garden is a familiar setting, but underneath the peonies and petunias is a much wilder hidden world, a miniature Serengeti, with beauty and brutality in equal measure. In this 90-minute documentary Chris Packham and a team of wildlife experts spend an entire year exploring every inch of a series of interlinked back gardens in Welwyn Garden City. They want to answer a fundamental question: how much wildlife lives beyond our back doors?

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde tries to illuminate the subject of trophy hunting from all sides. She talks to the Khwe chief, villagers and game guards in the Zambezi region. She meets a trophy hunter and follows the topic back to Germany, where she exchanges ideas with Izak Smit, the Chairperson of Desert Lions Human Relations Aid, Delhra in short.
programme.sub-title: Trophy hunting - just killing or conservation?

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Situated 1,000km west of Ecuador in South America, the Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world. It was the Galapagos islands' finches and mockingbirds that proved key to Darwin's theory of evolution.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: What seems calm and tranquil may not necessarily be so. Under the tranquility there maybe a vibrant dynamic world and above water there maybe dangers which are lurking at very corner. Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park is one such. In the Andaman Islands a group of 15 islands make up this fragile eco system. Coral, is one of the most productive and endangered wild fauna in the shallow coastal waters.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: In the heart of the Ivory Coast a small rural village has a very special resident. The last white rhino in the country sleeps on the village outskirts and feeds on the villagers' crops. He's survived a gunshot to the shoulder and a decade of civil war, and he's something of a celebrity here. But all is not well. The rhino has killed the chief of the village, and it's time for him to go.

programme.title: Costa Rica: The Rise of Nature

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to one of the oldest distilleries in America, Buffalo Trace, in Frankfort, Kentucky. Operating since the 18th century, its former president, Colonel Blanton, is believed to still be roaming the buildings. He worked and lived at the distillery for over 55 years, before passing away at his home, which was on the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called out to Hartford, CT to Elks Lodge, the oldest and largest secret fraternal organizations in the country. Elks Lodge #19 is shrouded in mystery and tragedy with a gruesome death hanging over its head....and decades of paranormal activity. Next they head to Morse Mill Hotel, in Morse Mill, Missouri - a hotel with a violent past. They are called in to help a client who is dealing with threatening spirits that emerged as renovations began.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Ohio to investigate Kings Island, an amusement park that sits on land that was the site of an awful accident. The workers here believe the people who died in the accident could be the ones still visiting the park. Some of the reported activity includes the sound of laughter, footsteps, objects being thrown, and a girl in a little blue dress who is said to be the ghost of a child buried in the nearby cemetery.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Naples, New York, to investigate the Naples Hotel. This hotel was built in 1895. There was a suicide at the hotel in the 1920's, which is when the activity is said to begin. The owners believe the ghost of the victim is still there and have nicknamed him "Topper." Some of the reported activity includes apparitions, voices, and objects being thrown.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hales Bar Dam and Marina in Tennessee, to investigate a dam that was built on Native American land. It is believed that a Cherokee chief cursed this property after he was forced off it. Due to numerous problems, Hales Bar Dam took eight years to complete and was finally finished in 1907. During the building of this dam there were many tragedies such as accidental deaths, including workers being buried alive in cement walls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates a 19th century Bed and Breakfast in Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee, built by the Cloyd family. Over the years, many members of the Cloyd family passed away at this property. The current owners, the Coles, believe the Cloyds never left and are haunting the hotel. People have seen several full body apparitions, matching the descriptions of various Cloyd members. Whistling has been heard, a lady in pink has been seen as well as a man in black.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Wythe County, Virginia to answer a call for help at one of the town's most feared houses - The Graham Mansion. This foreboding, twenty-five room home has witnessed a twisted history of evil through the centuries starting with a slave owner in the 1700's who was murdered by his two slaves. In the 1800's, Squire David Graham purchased the home. His wife suffered from mental illness and was locked-up in the basement.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS, minus Grant, answers a call for help from Providence City Hall where paranormal activity is threatening the staff. And now there is also concern for the hundreds of citizens who pass through this building every day. Built in 1878, this prominent building has the city's history tucked away between its walls, including a ghostly former mayor who is refusing to leave office...even when on the other side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out to investigate the U.S. Naval Institute in Annapolis, Maryland, where a marine's death remains a mystery and his ghost still roams the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's final case draws near, but that doesn't stop the TAPS team from helping those in need. They head to Mount Joy, Pennsylvania to investigate Bube's Brewery to see if the late owner, Alois Bube, and his deceased family members are still presiding over the lager business. Alois purchased the brewery in 1876 and added on a Victorian hotel to serve his beer and accommodate overnight guests.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's last show draws even closer, but in the meantime the cases keep coming, and this one is very exciting for the whole team; the USS Yorktown in Mt. Pleasant, South Carolina. This is an 872-foot warship, which served in WWII as well as Vietnam and also recovered the Apollo 8 astronauts and space capsule. The USS Yorktown has carried thousands of men and lost more than 140 of them while in battle. Most were pilots who never returned from their missions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

It was renamed the Spalding Inn in 1926 when Randall and Anna Spalding took over.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Jimmy Jr.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY

programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.sub-title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB

programme.desc: This episode focuses on the naval war in the Pacific during World War II. It will provide a glimpse of how is life on board of both these vessels.

programme.title: Mission Invisible
programme.desc: The largest nuclear submarine ever built is Russian. Carrying 20 ballistic missiles inside its 179 meter long hull, the Typhoon-class ship has been designed as the weapon of last resort. Until now however, only glimpses of the largest and deadliest killing machine on Earth have been available.

programme.title: Battlefields

However, all the Poilus who attack that day are sure..: This time it will be the end of the war. The offensive decided by the new commander-in-chief, General Nivelle, must take everything on its passage.
programme.sub-title: 1917 - The Second Battle of the Aisne

programme.title: Artillery: The Gods of War
programme.desc: Traditionally the artillery has been the major killer on the battlefield. The task of the infantry and cavalry have been to fix the enemy in place for the artillery to destroy them with massed fire. Traditionally the horse and foot artillery did the job with field guns and howitzers. The bulk of fire has been indirect as a result of advances in technology and man's understanding of ballistics.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: In a last effort at glory, having lost most of their best men in military actions, Japan employs suicide pilots - Kamikaze - men who willingly crash their planes into ships in order to destroy the American spirit. But the U.S. Navy and Marines are ready for them with their guns, and they fought heroically against the onslaught. And on Okinawa, Americans fight a major battle with the Japanese Army.

programme.title: The Wheels of Power - History of Official Cars
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler and his Mercedes 770K parade car, Charles De Gaulle and his DS 19, Pope Jean-Paul II and his Popemobiles, Donald Trump and The Beast, his ultra-safe limousine. All these Heads of State have given their cars a place in the great book of automobiles. Sometimes using these vehicles for their propaganda, certain of them didn't hesitate to use custom-made cars.

programme.title: The Concise History of WWII
programme.desc: From Germany's dramatic invasion of Poland, France, and Russia, to the Battle of Britain, the key battles in Africa, and onto the attack of Pearl Harbour and the eventual defeat of the Nazi army in Stalingrad. This program focuses on all the major events of this period, and also pays particular attention to the war's final year and the gradual destruction of the German army.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: General George C. Marshall and Henry 'Hap' Arnold are profiled.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: On July 3, 1940, the British fleet attacked the French navy at Mers el-Kébir, Algeria. In ten minutes, Bretagne sank, Mogador was destroyed, and Provence and Dunkerque were grounded. Over 1,300 French sailors died, a tragic outcome of allies turning against each other. Churchill justified the attack to prevent the ships from falling into German hands. This film examines this pivotal WWII moment.

programme.title: The Goering Catalog

But how did Hermann Goering obtain these works? This documentary explores these works and where they were hidden, through extensive photos and archives. At the same time, it tells the story of Nazism's systematic spoliation, often paid for in blood.

programme.title: Sacrifice: From D-Day to the Liberation of Paris

Hope rises as French populace anticipates liberation, despite slow Allied progress in Normandy. Paris liberated in August; war persists for another year, marking Normandy's profound sacrifice.

programme.title: Living in the Shadow of WWII
programme.desc: Every nation involved in the Second World War recognized that maintaining the morale of the population was vital. Everywhere a great effort was made to offer entertainment, diversion and often to package it with the reassurance that the cause was just and victory certain.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War

programme.desc: Aurelio llega al hotel donde se hospeda Mónica, y ella tiembla al verlo. El Turco le pide a Chacorta que se deshaga del cuerpo de Miss Sinaloa, ya que Marco Mejía viene en camino.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía le hace entrega a Ximena de los resultados de la autopsia realizada a Cleto Letrán, y le dice que está convencido de que fue Aurelio Casillas quien lo asesinó.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena se presenta en el cuarto del Turco y le dice que quiere estar con él. El Cabo está dispuesto a recuperar la confianza de los Casillas. Leonor se defiende del fuerte ataque de Parra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cuando ella quiere deshacerse de su embarazo, Heriberto y Matilde son secuestrados en Colombia. Leonor le dice a Ponte que deben investigar al Turco, hombre de confianza de Aurelio Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía le enseña a Benítez la grabación donde se demuestra que el general Jiménez Arroyo hace tratos con Casillas. Aurelio llama al Cabo y a Tijeras para que maten al Letrudo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio invita al Cabo a San Luis Potosí para eliminar a Colmenares, pero la relación es muy tensa entre ellos. Heriberto negocia con los secuestradores, y Matilde admira su valentía.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco llega a tiempo para salvar al Cabo de la ira de los Casillas, y les entrega los resultados de ADN de Tijeras como prueba de fidelidad. Chacorta sorprende a Matilde en Colombia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio llega al hotel para evitar que Ximena escape, donde se enfrenta al Turco por su engaño. Mejía le pide a Benítez que no le diga al presidente sobre sus sospechas del asesinato de Colmenares.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente Benítez le dice a Marco Mejía que lo respalda y que jamás negociará con criminales. Aurelio espera una respuesta. Chacorta lleva a Matilde al hospital, y Heriberto se pone muy mal.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio invita a comer a Ximena, pero el Cabo y sus hombres llegan hasta el restaurante donde él está y se presenta una balacera. Chacorta se venga de Heriberto al saber de su relación con Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta llevarse a Ximena al extranjero, pero ella logra desarmar a uno de los hombres de Aurelio y lo amenaza. Doña Alba no acepta irse con él, y le canta las verdades en su cara.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio regresa a México y se lleva una sorpresa cuando llega a la bodega, por lo que decide cambiarse el rostro. El Cabo le dice al Chema que él se encarga de encontrar a Casillas con ayuda de Irina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas se somete a cirugía estética, pero el procedimiento se complica y Heriberto pierde el control. Rutila le miente a Ximena por temor al Turco: le dice que extraña a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Todos creen que Aurelio Casillas ha muerto en una sala de operaciones. Sin embargo, la muerte que tanto impactó al mundo del narco mexicano es, en realidad, una mentira de quien busca venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio captura al Turco y lo tortura para descubrir dónde está el dinero que le robó. Mientras, el Chema Venegas, desconfiando de los Casillas, ordena a Tijeras secuestrar a doña Alba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de un tiroteo, Chacorta y sus hombres rescatan a doña Alba. El Chema se obsesiona con conocer la verdad sobre la muerte de Aurelio, y pide la lista de doctores que lo operaron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema les ofrece refugio al Turco y la familia de Aurelio en una de sus casas de Los Ángeles para tenderles una trampa. Mónica tiene que matar al cocinero para poder escapar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Dos hermanos gemelos demandan a su madre porque no están de acuerdo con el uso que hace de sus redes sociales. La mujer publica fotos sexualmente comprometedoras y busca pareja en todos los sitios web de citas. Ariel aumentó el tráfico en las redes sociales del negocio de su esposa con una práctica que lleva a cabo con todas las chicas que conoce: les rocía aceite en las nalgas, lo cual atrae seguidores.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nancy demanda a su hermana, por ella casi muere ahogada en una competencia de "pancakes". Héctor pide el divorcio y la custodia de sus hijas, su esposa lo traicionó con quien menos lo esperaba.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ashly contrató a un detective para aclarar el crimen de su esposo, pero ella lo resolvió y no quiere pagarle. Andrea culpa a Ruby y a Margy de la muerte de su padre y se disputan la herencia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Daniela y José es autista, tiene problemas de comunicación, pero si le dan su títere favorito no para de hablar, sus padres no saben qué hacer. Valentina sufre una enfermedad sexual.
programme.sub-title: Obsesión por títere; Semen en mi ojo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis y Pierina tienen una hija con cáncer que no quiere someterse a quimioterapia. Además, Raúl padece el síndrome de Tourette y siente que su novia no lo comprende, solo lo hace sufrir.
programme.sub-title: Salvando a mi hija; Síndrome de Tourette

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Kelvin y Lorena son esposos y periodistas, ella lo envía a entrevistar a un narcotraficante, pero lo secuestran y casi muere. Sharon contrata a Pedro para que le pegue, pero todo sale mal.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sufre de "bullying" y su madrastra la maquilla de muñeca diabólica para que huyan de ella. También, Danny es un usurero que da dinero en efectivo a cambio de usar las tarjetas de sus deudores.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ivandra queda colgada en una pared de escalar, cuando John deja de sujetarla, ella sufre daños en la muñeca. Los "Pony Play" se disfrazan y Pancho demanda a su esposa por maltrato animal.
programme.sub-title: Me dejaste colgada; Pancho y Romeo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis le paga a la esposa de Joel para alquilar su vientre, pero ella cae en coma. Por otro lado, Hilario es un gaucho que maneja con mucha destreza las boleadoras y los tambores.
programme.sub-title: El bebé de la Bella Durmiente; Gaucho con las bolas grandes

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Orlando pide que su hermano Neifry deje de comportarse como su madre fallecida. Karla se infecta con una bacteria al hacerse un tratamiento de belleza con peces. Ahora exige que cierren el spa.
programme.sub-title: Poseído por mamá; Fish spa chupitos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos demanda a Marcela, su madrastra, para quitarle la custodia de su padre enfermo. Daniel sacrifica burros para preparar una gelatina capaz de sanar a su hijo, pero su esposa se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mía estudia periodismo en una academia de Artes y Letras; allí, ganó un concurso literario, pero la organizadora no quiere entregarle el premio porque sostiene que su historia, su vida como prostituta, no es un buen ejemplo para los demás estudiantes. Michel se disfrazó de Kory y se presentó a un examen con la intención de ayudarla, pero fue descubierto y ambos fueron sancionados y expulsados del sistema educativo.
programme.sub-title: Historia de una prosti; Estafa universitaria

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Le dan somníferos para que se mantenga delgada y pueda modelar. Practicaba sexo extremo con la hermana de su esposa, ella muere y le deja una herencia que no puede cobrar por estar involucrado.
programme.sub-title: Dormir o comer; Amor a la muerte

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por presión de su esposo se hizo una operación gástrica, ahora siente que no es ella y quiere volver a engordar. Para cumplir con el testamento de su hermana deben sacrificar a un perro.
programme.sub-title: La gula; Entiérrame con el perro

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Henna y Miguel son incapacitados y quieren ser una familia independiente. Ivelis le exige compensación a Nicolás por publicar en las redes un video íntimo que la pone en ridículo.
programme.sub-title: Amor a lo Romeo y Julieta; Venganza del tigre

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Samuel y Chris son un dúo musical de niños, la mánager demanda a la mamá de uno de ellos porque no quiere firmar contrato con un show de televisión que les puede abrir las puertas del éxito.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Enrique no soporta la obsesión de su esposa por los cupones de descuentos, exige terapia psicológica. Anulan el contrato porque se besaron durante el experimento en el que fingían ser hermanos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Manuel tuvo una relación legal con una menor de edad, pero lo denuncian por entrar a su email sin permiso. Demandan a una profesora por resaltar lo peor de su alumno durante el funeral.
programme.sub-title: Entrenador embaraza a menor; Ofensa en el funeral

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Valentina y Juan tienen un programa radial sin audiencia, cuando él cambia el enfoque pone en peligro a los inmigrantes indocumentados. Los maniquíes semidesnudos de Cairo molestan a su vecina.
programme.sub-title: Radio de la frontera; Calientes, pero quietos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gabriel es un hombre lobo, algo que le fascina a Ana Lucía, su "roommate", quien lo acosa sexualmente. Lucy y su esposo hicieron un trío con un transexual, a quien él le deja su herencia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yasyky y su novio Yokymata viven su vida como si estuvieran dentro de una historia del universo Manga, el "Omegaverse". Como se sienten incomprendidos por la sociedad de E. UU. quieren irse a vivir a Japón, donde están más familiarizados con esta cultura, pero para ello necesitan la autorización de la madre del chico porque está incapacitado mentalmente. Mauricio quiere que su esposa deje las redes sociales porque están afectando su vida matrimonial, pero ella no puede despegarse de su teléfono.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tayra se traga casi 10 mil dólares para protegerlos de unos traficantes, luego los evacua y paga sus gastos médicos. César pone al niño a lamer piernas de mujeres porque su saliva es curativa.
programme.sub-title: Dinero tragado, dinero cagado; Chupa piernas

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.
